stem: One plant is wilted at the end of a bench while neighboring plants appear normal. What should the technician do before treating the entire room?
choices: Assume the room is too dry and increase irrigation everywhere
Document the localized plant, verify its delivery/root-zone condition and compare nearby plants before escalating
Increase nutrient strength for every plant
rationale: A single localized symptom should be investigated as a local pattern before a room-wide correction is considered.
